articles.title: Muscle dysmorphia symptoms linked to a range of sexual difficulties in young men
articles.summary: Young men with stronger muscle dysmorphia symptoms report more sexual difficulties, from anxiety during sex to erectile trouble. Anxiety about physical appearance showed the broadest links, while the drive to get bigger mattered less.

articles.summary: Among 7- to 9-year-olds, children who regularly practiced an instrument scored higher than peers of similar age, sex, and socioeconomic status on tests of general intelligence, working memory, reading, and math.

articles.title: Supernatural delusions are common in psychedelic-linked killings, studies find
articles.summary: Researchers have documented 626 homicides committed under the influence of psychedelics since 1962. Delusions appeared in about 28 percent of cases, and offenders who had them were far more likely to kill a partner, friend, or parent.

articles.title: MIT scientists discover a surprising way to boost the brain’s nighttime cleaning system
